All submitted documents shall bear the firm's registered mobile number, email ID and contact number, wherever applicable. Documents requiring authentication shall be duly signed and stamped by the authorized signatory of the fir m. The bidder must be a local supplier having a registered office/shop within Neemuch, Madhya Pradesh, or within an appro ximate radius of 50 KM from Neemuch. The bidder shall submit valid documentary proof of the registered business addr ess, such as GST Registration Certificate, Shop/Establishment Registration Certificate, or Udyam/MSME Certificate, for v erification.
